skill.name: notebooklm-manager
skill.description: Manage NotebookLM notebooks from Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The skill can query registered notebooks, add NotebookLM URLs, search the local notebook library, and manage notebook status through a Chrome agent.
skill.summary: Query and organize NotebookLM notebooks through a local registry and Chrome automation.
skill.author: LeeJuOh

security_audit.summary: Static findings are mostly false positives caused by Markdown backticks, NotebookLM example URLs, and plugin-scoped data paths. I found two contextual risks: dynamic URL delegation lacks explicit NotebookLM validation, and DATA_DIR is trusted from a hidden data-path file. No prompt injection attempt or obvious credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.suggestion: Validate that every URL uses https, the notebooklm.google.com host, and the expected notebook path before storing it or sending it to the Chrome agent.
After reading data-path, verify that DATA_DIR is inside CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA or the documented notebooklm-connector directory before any read, write, or edit.
Document that the skill uses an authenticated browser session and local plugin storage, so users understand what data may leave the chat.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Browser Navigation Target
semantic_findings.description: The workflow passes a supplied URL into the chrome-mcp-query agent without an explicit NotebookLM domain and path validation step. A non-NotebookLM URL could make the authenticated browser visit an unintended page.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited workflow shows URL forwarding to the browser agent, and no validation step appears in the add workflow. The skill description narrows intended use to NotebookLM, so confidence is moderate.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Data Directory Pointer
semantic_findings.description: The skill reads an absolute DATA_DIR value from a hidden data-path file and uses it for all subsequent file operations. If that pointer is changed, reads and writes could leave the intended plugin storage area.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly trust a single-line absolute path and then use it for config and library operations. The hook may normally write a safe path, but the skill text does not require path validation.

content.value_statement: Research notebooks become hard to manage when URLs, topics, and follow-up questions are scattered across chats. This skill creates a local notebook registry and uses a Chrome agent to query NotebookLM consistently.
actual_capabilities: Reads a local notebook library and configuration from the resolved plugin data directory.
Queries registered NotebookLM notebooks through the chrome-mcp-query agent.
Adds NotebookLM URLs with smart metadata discovery or manual metadata entry.
Lists, shows, searches, enables, disables, and removes notebook records.
Runs coverage checks and follow-up queries when NotebookLM misses requested topics.
Handles Chrome connection errors, authentication errors, empty answers, and long queries.
limitations: Requires the claude-in-chrome MCP setup and a connected Chrome or Edge session.
Requires a Google account with access to the target NotebookLM notebooks.
Works only with notebooks in its local library unless a notebook is added first.
May need updates when NotebookLM changes its browser interface or selectors.

use_cases.title: Research Notebook Lookup
use_cases.description: Ask a saved NotebookLM notebook for answers without finding and opening the notebook URL manually.

use_cases.title: Team Knowledge Registry
use_cases.description: Keep project notebooks searchable by ID, topic, and status across repeated Claude Code sessions.

use_cases.title: Documentation Review
use_cases.description: Query documentation notebooks and run follow-up checks when answers skip required topics.

prompt_templates.title: List Notebooks
prompt_templates.prompt: List my active NotebookLM notebooks and show their IDs, names, and topics.

prompt_templates.title: Add Notebook
prompt_templates.prompt: Add this NotebookLM URL to my library and discover its title, topics, and description.

prompt_templates.title: Query Notebook
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask the claude-docs notebook: What setup steps are required for Chrome MCP and hooks?

prompt_templates.title: Check Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask the product-research notebook about pricing, onboarding, objections, and integrations. Run coverage checks and follow up on missing topics.

output: Shows active notebook names with IDs and topics.
Keeps archived notebooks hidden unless the user requests them.

output_examples.input: Ask the claude-docs notebook about MCP setup and hooks.
output_examples.output: Returns the NotebookLM answer, checks whether both topics were covered, and suggests focused follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Add a NotebookLM URL with smart discovery.
output_examples.output: Extracts the notebook title and topics through the Chrome agent, then registers the notebook in the local library.

best_practices: Use stable, descriptive notebook IDs so search and follow-up prompts remain clear.
Keep questions focused when NotebookLM must answer from large or mixed-source notebooks.
Review smart-add metadata before relying on a notebook for repeated project work.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for non-NotebookLM URLs or arbitrary web browsing.
Do not paste private data into NotebookLM unless that data is approved for Google services.
Do not disable coverage checks for broad multi-topic research unless speed matters more than completeness.

faq.question: Does this skill open NotebookLM directly?
faq.answer: It delegates browser work to the chrome-mcp-query agent instead of calling Chrome MCP tools directly.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: You need claude-in-chrome MCP, a connected Chrome or Edge browser, and access to the target NotebookLM notebooks.

faq.question: Where are notebook records stored?
faq.answer: Records are stored in the plugin data directory resolved from the notebooklm-connector data-path file.

faq.question: Can it add notebooks automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. Smart add queries the notebook for title, topics, and description, then stores the result locally.

faq.question: Can it handle very long questions?
faq.answer: It checks the configured length limit and asks for smaller focused queries when needed.

faq.question: Does it replace NotebookLM source management?
faq.answer: No. It manages a local registry and queries notebooks, but source files still live inside NotebookLM.
